run_api_hello_endpoint: run the FastAPI plugin API to respond to GET /hello with a JSON greeting message
test_hello_endpoint: test the hello endpoint returns a JSON object with message, plugin, and version fields
build_fastapi_router: build a FastAPI APIRouter instance mounted at /api/plugins/example for dashboard plugin routes
summarize_plugin_api: summarize the plugin API module that defines a single GET endpoint for a greeting response
review_hello_function: review the hello async function that returns a JSON response with plugin name and version
